resources.string: Each reading is kept to two a week for one account, so palm reading asks you to sign in. Your saved readings and the compare view stay open on this phone without it.
Sign-in is not set up in this copy of the app yet, so new palm readings cannot be had here. Your saved readings stay open on this phone.
You were signed out. Sign in again to read your palm.
Questions about a reading need an account. Go back to the Palm tab and sign in to ask one.
That doesn\'t look like a palm. Take a photo of the inside of your hand, fingers spread.
That looks like the back of a hand — turn it over and photograph your palm.
The photo is too dark or blurred to read. Try again in good light, holding the phone steady.
This didn\'t use one of this week\'s readings.
